name: fantasy-football-agent
description: PPR fantasy football assistant: live stats, matchup difficulty, injury status, recent news, waiver-wire trends, draft rankings from actual production, and (with an optional free FantasyPros key) forward-looking draft projections that include rookies. Fetches live from free sources (nflverse, Sleeper, public RSS) — no hosted backend, no account required. Optional free remote-deploy path for phone access — see deploy/README.md.
